# Data Retention Policy

User records must be permanently deleted 90 days after account closure,
in accordance with our data retention policy. The retention period for
inactive user records is 90 days.

| Record type | Retention period |
| --- | --- |
| User records | 90 days |
| Audit logs | 365 days |

Refund requests are processed under the separate refund policy, which
defines eligibility windows and approval steps for a refund.
